::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/subscriptions/{sub}/entitlements"}
#docs
## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `sub` | `string` | **yes** | Subscription id (sub_…) |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `feature` | `string` | **yes** | Feature key |
| `value` | `string` | **yes** | "true"/"false" (switch), an integer, or "unlimited" (quota/meter) |
| `reset` | `object` | no | Meter features: when the allowance resets (every interval, the hour included), or `{"same_as_credits": true}` to renew with the plan credits. Null = the next invoice's usage window. Omitted = keep the stored reset. On a subscription, null uses the plan's reset. |
| `reset.every` | `string` | no | The reset's every. One of `hour`, `day`, `week`, `month`, `quarter`, `half_year`, `year`, `term`, `never`. |
| `reset.count` | `integer` | no | The reset's count. |
| `reset.anchor` | `string` | no | The reset's anchor. One of `subscription`, `calendar`. |
| `reset.same_as_credits` | `boolean` | no | Always true: renew with the plan credits. Send it alone. One of `true`. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `subscription_entitlement`. One of `subscription_entitlement`. |
| `id` | `string` | The entitlement id. |
| `subscription` | `string` | The subscription id. |
| `feature` | `string` | The feature key. |
| `value` | `string` | The value: `true` or `false` for a switch, an integer or `unlimited` otherwise. |
| `reset` | `object` | When the allowance resets, or the credits link. Null = the next invoice's usage window. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | Subscription entitlement set |
| `400` | Invalid value |
| `404` | No such subscription/feature |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/subscriptions/sub_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/entitlements" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "feature": "feat_XXXXXXXXXXXX01",
    "value": "West"
  }'
```
